Adds recent Switchly events and diagnostic log entries

Switchly is developed and supported by one person. I read support messages and bug reports as soon as possible, but replies can sometimes take up to 7 days depending on workload.\n\nPlease include debug info when reporting blocking, schedule, premium, or permission issues. This helps me understand what happened much faster.
Some devices do not offer an “Unrestricted” battery option. If you already enabled the highest available background setting for Switchly, that may already be the maximum supported on your device.
If exact alarms are not allowed, time-based schedules may be delayed or not run at the correct time.

Switchly needs Accessibility to detect opened apps and websites, react to in-app navigation, and enforce blocking, profiles, schedules, and usage limits. If it is off, major protection features will not work.
Needed only for the “Blocked notifications” feature. Without it, notification blocking won’t work.
Battery optimization can delay background work. Disable optimization for Switchly to improve reliability.
Exact alarms make time-based schedules fire on time. Some devices delay schedules when this is off.

Android requires precise location permission to read the current Wi‑Fi name (SSID). For best reliability with Wi‑Fi triggers, background location should also be allowed. On Android 13 and newer, some devices also require Nearby Wi‑Fi devices.
Android 12+ requires the Nearby devices/Bluetooth permission for Bluetooth-based schedules.

Xiaomi/Redmi/POCO note:

• Also enable Autostart for Switchly
• Set battery mode to No restrictions if that option exists
• Lock the app in Recents if possible
• If available, allow background activity for Switchly
• Toggle Accessibility off and on again if Android shows it as enabled but Switchly is not responding
Review setup steps, permissions, and features
